## Change summary

Describe the product or engineering outcome.

## Release type

Use one title prefix or label. The default is patch.

- `[major]` or `release:major` — breaking API, data, or product change
- `[minor]` or `release:minor` — backward-compatible feature
- `[patch]` or `release:patch` — fix, refinement, documentation, or hardening

## Validation

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal data were committed.
- [ ] Backend and frontend behavior is covered by tests.
- [ ] User-visible copy is professional and does not expose internal diagnostics.
- [ ] The preview deployment was reviewed when the change affects the UI.

Version files are updated automatically after this PR passes CI and is merged.
